items.title: Make the CSP script nonce unpredictable
items.why: cloudflare/security-headers-worker.js:247 builds the nonce as btoa('vs_' + windowId + '_nonce') with no secret, while the policy uses strict-dynamic. Anyone who can inject markup can compute the current nonce from the clock.
items.outcome: Injected markup can no longer carry a valid nonce; the 300-second HTML cache window is unchanged.
items.recipe: Derive the nonce as HMAC-SHA256(secret, windowId) with a new Worker secret, keep the window so the edge cache still works, and add a unit test proving the nonce differs from the clock-only value and changes with the secret.

premises.claim: Nonce is derived from the clock alone

L1.recipe: HMAC the window id with a Worker secret.

L2.recipe: Plus unit tests and a live header check on the apex.

L3.recipe: Per-request nonce with cache-key variation measured against edge hit rate.

evidence.interpretation: cloudflare/security-headers-worker.js:247 builds the nonce as btoa('vs_' + windowId + '_nonce') with no secret, while the policy uses strict-dynamic. Anyone who can inject markup can compute the current nonce from the clock.

executionLog.note: Nonce is now HMAC-SHA256 of the window under CSP_NONCE_KEY or a per-isolate random key (cloudflare/worker-lib.mjs deriveWindowNonce). Worker unit tests 72/72 including a new unpredictability test. Takes effect on the next Worker deploy.
